_texte.* Toate valorile, condițiile și termenel: * All values, conditions and deadlines can be configured in the back office by the SuperAdmin together with the integrated insurers.
_texte.Acces la un flux constant de cereri de p: Access to a constant flow of digital, pre-qualified and standardised policy requests — with no sales effort.
_texte.Asiguratorul definește tipurile de poliț: The insurer defines policy types, values, conditions and exclusions directly from the admin panel. Full control without depending on the My Darrin team.
_texte.Avantajele integrării în platforma My Da: The benefits of integrating with the My Darrin platform, the policy issuance flow, the claims assessment conditions and the back-office configuration.
_texte.Ce primește clientul My Darrin: What the My Darrin customer gets
_texte.Certificatul de garanție este emis și ar: The warranty certificate is issued and archived digitally in the customer's account. Accessible at any time from the dashboard, with all the details of the work, the partner and the policy.
_texte.Completezi formularul de parteneriat și: You fill in the partnership form and the licensing documents
_texte.Cum accesez datele pentru constatarea un: How do I access the data to assess a claim?
_texte.Cum este calculată prima de asigurare pe: How is the insurance premium calculated per order?
_texte.Cum sunt gestionate daunele produse de p: How is damage caused by unauthorised partners handled?
_texte.Da. Dacă o cerere nu corespunde condiții: Yes. If a request doesn't meet the conditions configured by the insurer, the system rejects it automatically and passes it on to the next insurers in the pool. If they all reject it, the SuperAdmin is alerted to resolve it manually.
_texte.Dauna raportată în termenul de garanție: Damage reported within the warranty period
_texte.Daunele aprobate sunt decontate în maxim: Approved claims are settled within 7 working days at most. The customer is notified at every stage of the resolution process.
_texte.Daunele produse din vina partenerilor ca: Damage caused by the fault of partners working and delivering on behalf of the platform is handled according to the standard procedure.
_texte.Definești tipurile de polițe, valorile ș: You define the policy types, values and specific conditions
_texte.Devino asigurator partener My Darrin: Become a My Darrin partner insurer
_texte.Din dashboard-ul asiguratorului în backo: From the insurer's dashboard in the back office, you have access to all the documents relating to the order: before/after report with GPS, photos, audit trail, tax invoice and the partner's details. They are all digitally certified and indisputable.
_texte.Documente necesare dosar daună: Documents required for a claim file
_texte.Fiecare comandă My Darrin generează auto: Every My Darrin order automatically generates a policy request. You access a predictable volume of pre-qualified requests, without prospecting or individual negotiations.
_texte.Flux constant de cereri, emitere automat: A constant flow of requests, automatic issuance, certified data and settlement within 7 days. Zero red tape.
_texte.Fotografii before/after cu timestamp GPS: Before/after photos with GPS timestamps and a digital signature are archived for every job — indisputable evidence in the event of a dispute.
_texte.Ghid pentru asiguratori parteneri My Dar: Guide for My Darrin partner insurers — how policies, the discount and platform integration work.
_texte.La checkout, clientul poate selecta o as: At checkout, the customer can select extended insurance at extra cost — higher cover, a longer term, protection for exceptional cases.
_texte.My Darrin are un sistem de KYC/KYB la on: My Darrin has a KYC/KYB system at onboarding — no unauthorised partner can accept orders. All damage covered by the policies is solely the fault of verified, authorised partners working on behalf of the platform. The insurer has access to the partner's full verification file.
_texte.My Darrin operează în RO, MD, DE, FR, BG: My Darrin operates in RO, MD, DE, FR, BG and is expanding. Integrated insurers access requests from all active markets where they are licensed.
_texte.Polița de daune execuție este inclusă au: The workmanship damage policy is included automatically in the price of the service. The customer doesn't need to do anything extra — they are protected from the moment of payment.
_texte.Pot refuza o cerere de poliță?: Can I decline a policy request?
_texte.Poți opera în toate piețele My Darrin un: You can operate in all the My Darrin markets where you are licensed: RO, MD, DE, FR, BG and future markets. The set of policies, conditions and values can be configured separately per market/country in the back office.
_texte.Protecție automată, documentație complet: Automatic protection, complete documentation and fast settlement — with no red tape and no stress.
_texte.PV before/after, fotografii GPS, audit t: Before/after report, GPS photos, complete audit trail — all the documents needed to assess a claim are already archived and certified on the platform.
_texte.Reclamația formalizată în platformă: The complaint formalised on the platform
_texte.Sistemul My Darrin trimite cererea simul: The My Darrin system sends the request to all insurers at the same time. The first to confirm issues the policy automatically. Zero manual red tape.
_texte.Sistemul te include în pool-ul de alocar: The system adds you to the automatic allocation pool. Requests from day one.
_texte.SuperAdmin verifică licențele, solvabili: The SuperAdmin checks licences, solvency and legal documents
_texte.Termenele și franșizele configurate de a: The deadlines and excesses configured by the insurer
_texte.Valoarea primei este predefinită de asig: The premium value is predefined by the insurer in the back office, according to the policy type and the service category. Darrin AI automatically applies the corresponding rule to each request. The premium can be fixed or a percentage of the order value, configurable per policy type.
_texte.Vina dovedită a partenerului executor: Proven fault of the executing partner
_texte.În câte piețe pot opera ca asigurator?: In how many markets can I operate as an insurer?
_texte.Suma păstrată ca garanție: The amount held as a guarantee
_texte.Clientul plătește cu cardul, prin proces: The client pays by card, through the payment processor, or by bank transfer to Home Best Pal SRL. The amount is held as a guarantee (escrow) and is released after the work is confirmed.
_texte.După confirmarea lucrării, prima de asig: After the work is confirmed, the insurance premium, with your configured discount (5–15%), is released from the amount held as a guarantee.
